preconditions.description: The number of houses in the village is an integer greater than 1 and less than or equal to 10^5.
Each road connects two houses with house numbers between 1 and N, inclusive.
No road connects a house to itself.
The total number of roads in the village is N-1.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two lines.
The total length of the shortest paths is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= N and v_i != i for v_i in output_assignment)
postconditions.description: Each villager is assigned to a new house with a house number between 1 and N, inclusive, and the new house is different from the old house.

postconditions.expression: exists(output_assignment) such that sum(shortest_path_length(i, v_i) for i in range(1, N+1)) == output_total_length
postconditions.description: There exists an assignment of new houses such that the sum of the shortest path lengths between the old and new houses is minimized.
